name: Benedictus
original_name: 書架のベネディクトゥス
source:
A member of the Punishment Squad and a subordinate of Georgius of the Rainbow. He's the older brother of Scholastica.
Benedictus was resurrected as half of Acedia by Misao, in the same body as Scholastica, remembering nothing but his mission to protect the seal.

[Edited from the [url=http://11eyes.wikia.com/wiki/Main_Page]11eyes wiki[/url].]
